gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-hoover: Hoover is a refined, sturdy serif with a generous opening into the e and ascenders cut short. Hoover's line has real pressure in it, while Nasalization above draws every stroke like a ballpoint, light and flat.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-trench-slab: Friendly and approachable, Nasalization floats its big lowercase letters well apart, each one set loose from the next. Trench Slab, the text serif, answers by packing caps tight against the x-height.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded, with tall lowercase bodies that fill the line. Neon, drawn like compass pencil at one thickness, earns its place when it goes big and brief.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-sentient: Neuropol draws a futuristic outline with a slim channel where the c opens, and no thick-thin shift anywhere. And Sentient, the text serif, brings a comfortable stroke contrast with pinched apertures, so the page gets steel cable above and softer ink below.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-bespoke-sla: Geometric and contemporary, Neuropolitical pulls its words apart letter by letter, with crossbars as thick as its stems. Bespoke Slab is the grounded half, with tall lowercase bodies.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-erode: Erode reads like an editorial text serif, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. And Neuropolitical stays a smooth glowing tube by comparison, while Erode swells gently and carries a longer passage with dignity.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-hoover: Refined and robust, Hoover has a low-contrast text serif build with a generous entry into the e's eye. Neuropolitical does its best work as a smooth, tube-like display line, while Hoover handles the reading.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-trench-slab: Dignified Trench Slab sits tight between x-height and caps. Neuropolitical glows as a display line with curves as thick as its straight stems, while the text serif body does the quiet, careful work.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-bespoke-slab: Powerful and ancient, Nordic spaces its letters like brush dabs far apart, and every stroke keeps a single thickness. Bespoke Slab, a classic serif, offers tall lowercase; give Nordic the larger size.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-erode: Ancient, heavy brush dabs placed far apart: that is Nordic, with cramped closed letters and no tilted stress in the rounds. Erode opens wide by comparison with a mellow stroke range, and shrinking Nordic would squeeze those pressed folds shut.
